label: Donate
description: The giving page and the questions donors ask.

settings.text: Every gift goes into food, fuel for the van and keeping Mill Hall warm.

settings.title: Is my gift tax-deductible?
settings.body: Yes. We send a tax receipt by email for every gift of $20 or more, within a week.

settings.title: Can I change or stop a monthly gift?
settings.body: Any time, from the link in your receipt. Or write to us and we will do it for you.

settings.title: How is my gift spent?
settings.body: On food, the van's fuel and keeping the hall warm. Our yearly report lists every line.

settings.title: Can I give food instead?
settings.body: Yes. We take tins, dry goods, toiletries and warm coats at Mill Hall on any pantry day.
